review_notes: Read the whole target file. I compared it with the sibling proofs ObservableSuccessfulCompletion, CompletionBits, DesignatedBranchSuccess and CopyComparison. I also read Comparison.favorable_red_rule and Comparison.surrogate_success. The same red-destination discharge block, and the same hdisj/hcover and hrD-from-hTimage steps, appear in at least three Sampling-namespace proofs: Zero, Observable and CompletionBits. The Fin n BitMachine variants repeat the same case split, using SortedIndex.enum and the .real state. I did not compile anything. The suggested lemma is a sketch and assumes it would live in the Recovery layer, after favorable_red_rule. The proposed `favorable_red_selected` lemma is stated for a plain `r : V`, so it works in both the Subtype.val and SortedIndex.enum settings. The `.real` variants would need `s.real` and a small `colorClass`/`green` unfolding, which I have not checked. I did not review `zero_successful_probability`, which is a thin wrapper and has no duplication worth extracting.

findings.problem: The final `hredDest` argument to `surrogate_success` is discharged by a block that is copy-pasted across proofs. The block derives `hrD : r ∈ redD`, calls `favorable_red_rule`, then does a three-way `cases` on `selectedDestination` to rewrite `designatedDestination` into the `match` that `surrogate_success` expects. The same eight to ten lines appear verbatim in ObservableSuccessfulCompletion and CompletionBits. DesignatedBranchSuccess and CopyComparison repeat the same case split with `SortedIndex.enum`. `favorable_red_rule` is stated in terms of `designatedDestination`, but `surrogate_success` consumes `selectedDestination`, so every caller redoes this translation. The `hdisj` and `hcover` steps (`rw [hTimage]; exact (designated_partition Rstar dest).1/.2`) are repeated in the same way.
findings.proposed_change:
Add one lemma next to `favorable_red_rule` in Recovery/DestinationFacility.lean, taking the same arguments as `favorable_red_rule` for `kappa := 1/1000000` and `theta := 19/50`, with `u : V` and `hu : u ∈ designatedRed (C.nonproxy \ s.deleted) (C.designatedDestination hD s (19/50))`:

lemma favorable_red_selected ... : match selectedDestination (19/50) (C.coveredCenter s) (leafCenter s) (leafRadius s) (C.destinations s) (C.destinations_nonempty hD s) u with | .proxy φ => φ ∈ colorClass (S \ s.deleted) colors 0 | .covered _ => True | .uncovered _ => False.

Proof: `have hh := C.favorable_red_rule hD _ _ s hs colors hcolors u hu`, then `cases hd : selectedDestination ...` with the three existing branches (`simpa only [designatedDestination, hd] using hh`, `trivial`, `simp only [designatedDestination, hd] at hh`).

Use in the target: replace lines 73-82 with `intro r hrT; exact C.favorable_red_selected hD s hs colors hcolors (r:V) (by rw [← hTimage]; exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨r,hrT,rfl⟩)`. The hypotheses stay `hs`, `colors`, `hcolors`, `r` and `hrT` from the surrounding context. The Observable and CompletionBits proofs shrink the same way, with the same `hrD` argument. The Fin n variants pass `SortedIndex.enum red r` as `u`. They need only a final `simpa [Comparison.colorClass, green, RationalSampling.State.real]` for the `.proxy` case, which is the only extra step they have today.

Optionally, also factor `hdisj` and `hcover` into a helper `designated_image_partition`, taking `T`, `redD` and `hTimage` and returning the pair. The current `simpa ... using (designated_partition Rstar dest).2` special-case for `hBlue = ∅` in the target stays a one-line call.
findings.benefit: The match-translation lemma becomes a single named fact, `favorable_red_selected`, instead of five-plus copies of the same case analysis. Any future change to `designatedDestination`, `selectedDestination` or the `surrogate_success` hypothesis shape then needs one edit. Each success theorem shrinks to `apply C.surrogate_success ...` plus a one-line argument. A reader sees the real content: red nodes map to green proxies or covered centres, and uncovered destinations are impossible for red nodes.
